title: Chandra Chakori
desc: Puttaraju and Sevanthi fall in love with each other. Sevanthi's father puts forth a condition for their marriage which Puttaraju must fulfil.

title: Mungaru Male 2
desc: Preetham, the son of Suryakanth, a millionaire, is driven by excitement and easily gets bored when it comes to relationships. He understands love after he meets Nandini.

title: Habba
desc: A dark secret from Seetha's past keeps her from marrying Ram, her lover. Luckily for the couple, Ram's brothers are determined to get them back together.

title: Benki
desc: When antisocial elements in a humble village community harass a young woman, her protective brother embarks on a path of vengeance.

title: Vedha
desc: A father and daughter embark on a killing spree in a bid to seek revenge against those who have wronged them. However, a police officer seeks to put an end to their murders.
